verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero exposes an MCP *server* (xero-mcp-server) so external AI agents can call Xero's tools, and an 'AI Toolkit' for building agents against Xero — but this is the opposite direction of the story. There is no evidence that Xero itself (or its AI assistant JAX) can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of Xero consuming/connecting to external MCP servers, JAX or in-app tool configuration for third-party MCP tools.
